Package index

Build an operator

One generic dispatching on its first argument, plus named constructors for the operators that appear constantly inside expressions.

linop()
Build a linear operator
linop_eye()
Identity operator
linop_scaling()
Diagonal operator
is_linop()
Is this a linop?
dtype()
The scalar type of an operator

Operators on a sequence space

An operator whose index set is infinite, the truncation that makes it computable, and the rate its eigenvectors decay at. What comes back from the truncation is an ordinary operator, and what comes back from a spectral computation on it is a statement about the operator underneath.

linop_jacobi()
A Jacobi operator on the sequence space
finite_section()
Truncate an operator on a sequence space
decay_rate()
How fast an eigenvector decays

Views

The conjugate transpose, distinct from the transpose.

adjoint()
The conjugate transpose

Inspect and cost an expression

Read the structure of a lazy expression, estimate its cost, and trade cost for memory where that pays.

explain()
Report the structure and cost of an expression
linop_cost()
Estimated flops per column
collapse()
Collapse cheap subexpressions into dense leaves

Form a matrix, deliberately

Explicit materialisation, guarded on size.

as.matrix(<linop>)
Materialise an operator as a dense matrix
as_sparse()
Materialise an operator as a sparse matrix

Capabilities and evidence

What an operator knows about itself, the argument that established it, and what a solver will accept.

cap()
Read a capability off an operator
capability()
A capability value together with its evidence
evidence()
Describe the argument behind a capability value
evidence_satisfies()
Does this evidence satisfy a requirement?
requirement()
State what evidence a solver will accept

Check a claim

The conformance suite an adapter author runs before shipping.

verify()
Check that a claim is valid

Read a certificate

Each verb puts its certificate where its own return value has room. This reads it off any of them.

certificate()
Read the certificate off a result

Solve a system

One verb over seven Krylov methods, choosing on declared capabilities and shape, returning what a matrix solve returns with a certificate attached.

solve(<linop>)
Solve a linear system

Eigenvalues and singular values

Restarted Lanczos with full reorthogonalisation, and the same loop on the augmented operator. Each pair carries a backward error and a bound on how far the value can be from an exact one.

eigs()
Eigenvalues and eigenvectors of a hermitian operator
svds()
Singular values and vectors of an operator

Preconditioners

One direction internally, and a contract each method enforces at the point the preconditioner is accepted.

preconditioner()
Build a preconditioner
as_preconditioner()
Treat an approximate inverse as a preconditioner
as_preconditioner_inverse()
Treat an operator P ~ A^-1 as a preconditioner
